content.hypothesis: Prioritizing search of receptacles that match the destination type (e.g., drawers if placing on a drawer) reduces total steps compared to scanning all visible receptacles in arbitrary or listed order.
content.realization_pattern: Filter visible receptacles by type matching the destination; iterate through filtered subset before unfiltered remainder.
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden in a receptacle and the destination is also a receptacle type present in the room.
